name: future-css
description: A modern, accessible CSS design system with components for AI chat and general applications

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:wasm
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:rust
scripts.test:rust: cargo test && cargo test --workspace --no-default-features && cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --target wasm32-unknown-unknown

exportsDescriptions../editor: Rich text editor behavior. Requires no WASM or Rust toolchain.
exportsDescriptions../menu: Context menu behavior, roving focus, and focus restoration.
exportsDescriptions../grid: Data grid navigation, range selection, and cell editing.
exportsDescriptions../webview: Embedded-browser chrome: navigation, address bar, load states.
exportsDescriptions../urls: URL safety helpers shared by the editor and webview.
exportsDescriptions../selection: Selection queries backing the editor's toolbar state.
exportsDescriptions../highlight: Syntax highlighting for JS/TS, JSON, CSS, Rust, HTML, and Markdown. Returns contiguous, non-overlapping spans that preserve the source text exactly.
exportsDescriptions../ansi: ANSI SGR parsing into the terminal's styled runs: the sixteen colours and six attributes, streaming across chunk boundaries. Has a Rust crate with matching output.
exportsDescriptions../icons: The built-in icon set: inline SVG markup, DOM elements, and a symbol sprite. Pure data; no icon font or CDN.
exportsDescriptions../diff: Line diff (Myers), stats, and line splitting. Reconstructs both inputs exactly; suitable for git-style summaries.
exportsDescriptions../markdown: Markdown parse and serialize for the documented, round-trippable subset.
exportsDescriptions../select: Select / listbox behavior: roving highlight, typeahead, filtering, and focus retention. Requires no WASM or Rust toolchain.
exportsDescriptions../composer: Chat composer behavior: IME-safe entry, send/stop lifecycle, and attachments. Requires no WASM or Rust toolchain.
exportsDescriptions../context-strip: Context strip: provider, model, effort, and model parameters resolved as one state. Requires no WASM or Rust toolchain.
exportsDescriptions../git: Git surface: branch, status counts, file list, and per-file line stats. Renders caller-supplied status entries; does not run git. Has a Rust crate with a JS fallback.
exportsDescriptions../splitter: Drag-to-resize on the WAI-ARIA window splitter pattern: split panes and resizable edges, keyboard and pointer. Requires no WASM or Rust toolchain.
